result.paraphrase: Gigabyte GeForce RTX 2080 Ti Gaming OC WINDFORCE 3X 11GB GDDR6 352-bit graphics card, model GV-N208TGAMING OC-11GC. Features the WINDFORCE 3X cooling system with three 82mm unique-blade fans, alternate spinning fan design, six composite copper heat pipes, heat-pipe direct touch, and 3D active fan functionality for efficient heat dissipation at lower temperatures. Gigabyte’s alternate spinning reduces turbulent airflow by rotating the middle fan in the opposite direction, improving airflow pressure. The pure copper heat pipes maximize direct contact with the GPU and extend to the VRAM via a large metal plate contact for proper cooling.
